chunk_map.heading: Phase 1: Author the skill through conversation
Answer from how your codebase really tests
Phase 2: Invoke the skill on this codebase
Sharpen the skill from what came back
Decide if it graduates to the team

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess/predict-before-reveal construction anywhere in the file.

Checked all sub-items across all 8 chunks: no "Not X. Not Y. Z." construction; no anaphora/epistrophe triples; no self-grading superlatives about the exercise/skill ("same-window self-charity" at chunk 4 is an explained, in-context coinage about the pedagogy, not a value-prop-leak superlative); no number-with-retraction; no abstraction-noun stacks; no verb triplets with an empty leg.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No repo/maintainer vocabulary (surface-as-noun, firing, compendium, forcing function, beat, mood, Connections) found in body. "worktree" and "m3-quality" are legitimate delivery-architecture terms exposed to students by design, not curriculum-authoring dialect.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body bold spans are limited to widget/label chrome (Time/Window/What you do/What you build/The point/Prompt/What happened/Note) plus "Quick timebox note." (chunk 0), a short callout label functioning the same as the exempted widget leads elsewhere in this file. No bolded narrative lead sentences, no per-bullet bold monoculture. Consistent with the 2026-07-09 emphasis pass noted in the maintainer block.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Standard exercise file; both site/layouts/curriculum.js and site/layouts/slides.js wrap exercise pages in section.phase.phase--exercise, which buildDeckModel() picks up via querySelectorAll('.phase--lecture, .phase--exercise'). Content reaches the composed Slides deck.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Content-ordinal headers "Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3" (chunks 1, 3, 5) are consecutive from 1. In-file "Phase K" prose references ("the reasons for personal-first land in Phase 3" chunk 1; "The agent wrote it there in Phase 1, sharpened by your push-back during Phase 2's invoke-and-critique" chunk 5) all resolve to headers that exist in this file at the stated numbers. No cross-file phase references in body.
